name: contractbook
description: Search, read and draft Contractbook documents from Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to your Contractbook account. Claude can list and search documents, read their full text, browse templates and create draft documents from a template. Drafts are never sent for signature.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: Lists documents with filtering, sorting and pagination

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Full-text search across document content and attachments

tools.name: get_document_content
tools.description: Returns a document's full text as markdown

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists the contract templates available to the user

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Returns a template's details, including its data fields

tools.name: create_document_from_template
tools.description: Creates a draft document from a template

api_key.title: Contractbook API key
api_key.description: Create one in Contractbook under Settings → API keys.
